column1: # BiLing contrast corpus — measuring what CONTEXT is worth.
# Design. Every item shares its pinyin key with at least one sibling item whose
# context selects a DIFFERENT expected text. With context stripped
# (--no-context) the two are indistinguishable, so no system can get both
# right; with context an ideal system can. The gap between the two runs is
# therefore a direct measurement of the value of context handling, on
# ambiguities a literate human resolves without thinking. Items were chosen
# for being real disambiguations, not for being ones the engine happens to
# pass; misses are information, not embarrassments.
#   homophone — word pairs/triples with identical toneless pinyin whose
#       meanings force the choice (权力/权利, 泄漏/泄露 …). 需要/须要 is the
#       weakest pair — the distinction is prescriptive (须要 = 必须) and many
#       writers use 需要 everywhere — but it is the classic style-guide case
#       and is kept, flagged as such.
#   particle — 的/得/地 and 在/再: highest-frequency homophones in the
#       language; the preceding word class decides, and every IME must get
#   pronoun — 他/她/它 for key `ta`: the referent in the preceding clause
#       decides gender/animacy. This is precisely what n-gram context and an
#       LM can do and frequency alone cannot.
#   mixed — the same Latin key read as an English word after English context,
#       and as a pinyin syllable after Chinese context (me, sun, long): the
